client_steps.instruction: Come to the Birthing Station when in labor.

Lie on the delivery table and follow the Health Care Provider's instructions.
Lie in lithotomy position as instructed for delivery.
Continue lying in lithotomy position while newborn care is provided.

Listen to instructions and undergo the discharge examination before being discharged.
Listen to home-care instructions, receive home medications, and sign the discharge slip once you agree with the findings.
